power.title: ⚡ Power management
power.hint: Commands are accepted asynchronously. After sending, the bot checks the server state for you.
power.confirm_off: Forced power-off is like pulling the plug. Unsaved data may be lost.
power.confirm_shutdown: A graceful shutdown stops the server through its operating system (requires VMware Tools).
power.confirm_reboot: A graceful reboot restarts the server through its operating system (requires VMware Tools). Running services will be interrupted.

traffic.note: ℹ️ Only inbound (download) traffic counts toward the quota; upload is shown for information.

usage.res_unavailable: Live resource figures are not available right now.
usage.daily_none: No daily traffic data for this range.

topup.title: Traffic top-up
topup.hint: Pick a one-time traffic package. It is added on top of the monthly quota and unused volume carries over.
topup.none: No top-up packages are currently offered for this server.
topup.invoice_note: An invoice will be created. The traffic is added once it is paid.
topup.paid_now: ✅ The invoice is already paid — the traffic is being added.
promo.prices_undiscounted: Prices are shown without a discount.
promo.prompt_topup: 🏷 Send your promo code for this top-up (traffic codes only).
promo.prompt_renew: 🏷 Send your promo code for this renewal.
renew.title: Renew service
renew.explain: A renewal invoice can be issued within 14 days before the due date. Issuing it does not charge you — you pay it afterwards. If an unpaid renewal invoice already exists, it is reused (no duplicates).
renew.invoice_note: A renewal invoice will be issued (or the existing unpaid one returned). Nothing is charged until you pay it.
inv.title: Invoices
inv.limit_note: ℹ️ TrustHost returns only your 20 most recent invoices.
inv.pay_hint: Choose how to pay this invoice.
pay.title: Pay from wallet
pay.confirm_q: Pay this invoice from your wallet?
pay.insufficient: Your wallet is short by {missing}. Add funds or pay online.
pay.usdt_ready: ₮ Your USDT payment link is ready.
pay.after_note: After paying, press “Check status”. An invoice counts as paid only once TrustHost confirms it.
order.title: Order a service
order.no_groups: No product groups are available right now.
order.no_products: There are no products in this group.
order.enter_text: Send the value as a message:

order.prompt_domain: Send the domain name (for example example.com):
order.prompt_password: 🔑 Send the initial root/administrator password (at least 8 characters). Your message is deleted right away and the password is never stored.
order.price_note: ℹ️ The final total, including configurable options, is shown on the invoice.
order.duplicate: You already have an unpaid order for this product — showing it
order.next_pay: The service is provisioned after the invoice is paid.

help.text: ℹ️ Help Use the buttons — commands are shortcuts: /menu — dashboard /servers — my servers /orders — order a service /invoices — invoices /wallet — wallet /usage — resource & traffic usage /support — support tickets /settings — settings /health — diagnostics /cancel — cancel the current action
help.unavailable: 🚫 Not available through the TrustHost Customer API This feature is not available through the TrustHost Customer API: • reinstalling the operating system • changing the root password or the IP address • resizing a server • DNS management • depositing funds inside Telegram (use the Add Funds page) • editing your profile Use the TrustHost client area or open a support ticket for these.
